title: Agent Archivist run result (archivist.cli-result/v1)
description: The result document of the `run --once` command (plan Phase 5; CLI-015): one foreground scheduling cycle — the startup reconciliation that drains the spool's crash debris, the spool-pressure policy's verdict for new materialization, and the two-lane scheduler's work order for the round (drain first, then one freshness reservation per active source, then largest-first backfill under the per-source quantum). Every figure is a content-free counter or a closed-vocabulary token; no field carries a path, a transcript body, a secret value or reference string, or an unbounded identifier (SEC-004, CFG-027).

x-archivist.compatibility: member additions are additive within v1 per plan Section 7.1 (CLI-015); redefining or removing a member, or a new namespace, is a v2 event

schema.description: The CLI result namespace. Present in every result document so a consumer always knows which contract it is reading before anything else (VAL-001); an unknown namespace is not this format and fails closed.

generated_at.description: The instant the cycle ran (plan Section 7.3).

reconcile.description: What the cycle's startup reconciliation pass found and did.

pressure.description: The spool-pressure policy's verdict for new materialization this round (plan Section 7.9, OPS-03/EC-11).

plan.description: The round's arithmetic, as the scheduler spent it.

orphan_bundles_indexed.description: Complete bundles with no state row, indexed back into the pipeline.

acknowledged_bundles_removed.description: Bundles of already-acknowledged entries removed from disk.

staging_files_removed.description: Staging files of interrupted materializations removed.

unclassified_entries.description: Entries the reconciler could not classify and deliberately left in place.

spool_rows_missing_bundles.description: Live state rows whose bundle file is missing — a corruption signal, never repaired here.

reconcile-report.description: The reconciliation pass's counts; never names, paths, or digests.

admits_materialization.description: Whether the policy admits new materialization this round.

degraded.description: Whether any degraded reason is named.

items.description: One closed reason token; unknown tokens are not this format.

reasons.description: The degraded reasons in canonical order; empty when materialization is admitted.

spool_bytes.description: The live spool usage this evaluation measured.

free_bytes.description: The filesystem free space this evaluation measured.

spool_cap_bytes.description: The high-water cap the evaluation applied.

free_floor_bytes.description: The free-space floor the evaluation applied.

resume_threshold_bytes.description: The resume threshold the evaluation applied: usage at or below it releases a latched pause.

pressure-verdict.description: The policy verdict: admission, reason tokens, measurements, and the applied limits.

capacity_bytes.description: The materialization capacity the round was given.

drain_entries.description: Pending spool entries the drain phase covers.

drain_bytes.description: Pending spool bytes the drain phase covers.

eligible_sources.description: Sources with measured, schedulable backlog this round.

reserved_sources.description: Active sources that received their reservation chunk.

backfilled_sources.description: Sources the backfill pass granted this round.

planned_bytes.description: Bytes the round plans to materialize: reservations plus backfill.

short_reservations.description: Active sources denied their reservation because the round's capacity could not cover every one. Never silent: a round this large reports the shortfall and spends nothing on backfill.

deferred_sources.description: Sources with residual backlog that received no backfill grant this round.
